nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the FastAPI backend using python:3.11-slim, installing Pillow system libraries (JPEG/PNG/WEBP/TIFF), Python dependencies from requirements.txt, and launching the application via a start.sh entrypoint on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: Installs native image-processing libs (libjpeg62-turbo, libwebp7, libtiff6) at the OS level before pip-installing Pillow, which is the correct pattern for Pillow binary compatibility on slim Debian images.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion file that strips Python caches, virtual environments, SQLite databases, and test/type-check cache directories from the image to keep the build context lean and prevent secrets (.env) from leaking into the image.
